Shah Rukh Khan spotted at Lalbaugcha Raja, video goes viral

Bollywood actor Shah Rukh Khan was seen at the Lalbaugcha Raja Ganpati pandal. A video circulating online shows Khan wiping his face with a dupatta belonging to his manager, Pooja Dadlani. Fans reacted to the video, with some commenting "King ho toh aisa" (If you are a king, be like this).
